messages.subject: Natural Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Strategic Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Goldrick Consulting Team,

Your executive-search work across natural resources, mining, energy and infrastructure aligns closely with my current leadership portfolio.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where resource development, regulatory strategy, stakeholder trust and sustainability execution must operate as one integrated leadership agenda. My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future searches.
